textRuns.value: How to read: each row is a typical flat for that town and flat type, estimated by the selected model for the last full month. Estimates were computed in Python in advance - changing a slicer filters the table, it does not re-run the model.

Typical error = the larger of the town and flat-type median % error measured on the test year. Indicative only: not a valuation, not the price of any specific unit, and not suitable for loan or negotiation decisions.
